what: The query replies of an RS-3005P bench power supply (KA3005P command set), as issue #730 lists them. The RS-3005P backend decodes exactly these and nothing it has not seen.
how: transcribed from issue #730; raw bytes not available; not a recording made by this run
conditions: pyserial 3.5 on Windows, queries only: no setter, output or protection command was sent
framing: A command sent without a terminator is answered without one; the same command terminated by a newline is answered with a trailing newline.
pacing: VSET1?ISET1? written back to back without a gap: only VSET1? is answered. The reply is read before the next command is sent.

exchanges.note: the serial is redacted; the issue gives the reply length with the real serial

exchanges.meaning: one raw byte, not ASCII text
